from solution import solve
# Test monotonicity
xs = [3, 1, 4, 1, 5]
base = solve(xs)
for p in [1, 2, 7, 100]:
    assert solve(xs + [p]) > base, (p, solve(xs + [p]), base)
# Test residue and bound
for n in range(0, 20):
    v = solve([1]*n)
    assert v % 5 == n % 5, (n, v)
    assert v <= 40, (n, v)
print('ok', solve([1]*20))
